Priya,

Thanks for the redline. I reviewed the publicity and logo sections with our legal ops team — see attached summary (GreenWave_Confidentiality_Questions.pdf). High level comments:

1) Publicity: GreenWave cannot grant broad, unconditional logo use. We can agree to:
   - Customer may appear in Redwood partner directory (logo + 1-line description) after internal comms approval;
   - Joint press releases require a 30-day review and mutual sign-off;
   - Case studies permitted but must be pre-approved by GreenWave legal & marketing.

2) Confidentiality: We need tighter carve-outs around aggregated telemetry. Please clarify that any telemetry shared with Redwood for product improvement will be de-identified and aggregated.

3) Reference calls: OK on a limited basis, but we need an opt-out for specific customer contacts and a cap of 3 reference calls per quarter.

I’ve highlighted the exact lines in the PDF. If Redwood can accept the edits above, we can greenlight commercial terms with procurement.

Regards,
Michael Chu
Senior Counsel, GreenWave Health
mchu@greenwavehealth.com

Thanks Michael for the clear asks — copying the internal team so we can respond with an implementable compromise. Below is a suggested set of edits we can propose back to GreenWave (I’ll paste into the redline if priya is ok):

PROPOSED COMPROMISE (for publicity and logo use):
- Partner Directory: Redwood may list GreenWave’s name and logo in a partner/customer directory on redwood.ai with prior written approval ("Approval" defined as consent by an authorized GreenWave marketing contact).
- Press Releases & Case Studies: Either party must provide a 30-calendar-day notice and obtain written approval before distribution. Approval will not be unreasonably withheld; both parties agree to a single round of reasonable edits limited to factual corrections.
- Reference Calls: Up to 3 reference calls per quarter; GreenWave may designate up to 5 personnel who are authorized to accept reference requests.

CONFIDENTIALITY (telemetry):
- Any product usage data shared for product improvement or benchmarking will be aggregated and de-identified; individual customer data or PHI (if present) will not be included.

If that looks good I’ll push these into the redline and ask Priya to send back to Michael/Sara. Marcus — if billing needs any change to the Order Form based on this (e.g., marketing co-fund credit) flag it here. Rishi — any compliance concerns on telemetry language?

Monica Patel
